title: PID-Comm: A Fast and Flexible Collective Communication Framework for Commodity Processing-in-DIMM Devices
problem: Processing-in-memory DIMMs suffer from significant overhead in inter-PE collective communication due to slow CPU-mediated communication methods, preventing broader application acceleration.
motivation: While PIM-enabled DIMMs can overcome data movement bottlenecks for memory-intensive operations, communication overhead between processing elements limits performance gains and system adoption.
method: PID-Comm abstracts processing elements as a multi-dimensional hypercube, enabling flexible instances of inter-PE collective communication along specific dimensions. It defines eight inter-PE collective communication patterns for applications to express complex communication needs, then provides optimized implementations of these patterns for commodity UPMEM DIMMs.
key_novelty: Multi-dimensional hypercube abstraction for processing elements enables flexible, high-performance collective communication without CPU mediation.
contributions: Hypercube-based abstraction framework for organizing processing elements in PIM DIMMs
Eight standardized inter-PE collective communication patterns
Optimized implementations for commodity UPMEM DIMMs
Up to 5.19x performance improvement over existing inter-PE communication methods
limitations: Evaluation limited to UPMEM DIMMs; generalization to other PIM architectures and scalability beyond 16 DIMMs not discussed.
